text.en: Pet owners speak warmly of Dr. Romeo and the clinic staff, highlighting their kindness, responsiveness, and professional bedside manner. Reviewers appreciate that the team remembers individual pet personalities and quirks. Families value the genuine empathy displayed during difficult circumstances, including sudden end-of-life care.

Clients report prompt and successful clinical interventions, including emergency foreign object removal surgeries and thorough wellness examinations. Reviewers note that pets recover comfortably and quickly under the veterinary team's supervision. Pet parents express confidence in the medical evaluations and post-surgical care.

Reviewers emphasize how comfortable dogs and cats feel during routine visits and urgent treatments. Clients note that staff take time to soothe older animals and handle excitable pets gently. Families appreciate the personalized attention given to both feline and canine patients throughout examinations.

q.en: Can CityVet Southtown accommodate same-day urgent surgeries?

a.en: Yes, clients report that urgent foreign object removal procedures have been accommodated on the same day.

q.en: Does the clinic follow up after appointments?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that staff make follow-up phone calls and allow communication via text and photo updates.

q.en: Is parking available at this location?

a.en: Yes, dedicated parking is available at the rear of the clinic building on South Alamo Street.

q.en: Are both cats and dogs treated at this facility?

a.en: Yes, the practice regularly cares for both canine and feline patients for exams, dentistry, and surgery.
